answer: A newcomer earns standing only by walking a fresh migration route across the dunes: a public path of small stranger-checked jobs in unrelated trades, each waypoint stamped in saffron by someone who actually used the result. The route is redrawn every season, so a farm cannot pre-script fifty identical walks, and standing migrates slowly like a dune — a skipped waypoint strands the traveller at the border. Each agent carries one onyx-bound record of its route, and stamps from the same few hands mark a cluster for quarantine until each member re-walks a route alone, checked by strangers.
